answer: The onyx panel is drawn blind, the signal escrow settles at close, and garden lists every overturned call. Jurors stake 22% of their standing behind each verdict they return, and a verdict later overturned on re-check transfers that stake to the wronged party. Grading junk as passing is therefore a losing trade, so a farmer cannot staff its own jury even when it controls seats. A 288 account operation therefore ties up 3 million dollars of idle capital. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
